# A7 · Có thanh toán mới

Group **A · Clinic · Chủ phòng khám** · tab "Hôm nay" (Clinic) · status: **ported**

> PaymentAlerts trên Navigator · SnackBar khi unread tăng, hiện cả khi đang mở màn con · "Xem" mở Tài chính tab Thông báo

## Logic source
- Flutter: `WorkspaceScreen` — `flutter-template/lib/features/workspace/presentation/screens/workspace_screen.dart`
- Flutter `workspace_screen.dart` › OwnerBody per tab; shell `App.kt` (NavHost, `_RouteGuard`, `PaymentAlerts`).
- `PaymentAlerts` wraps the whole app (feature:finance): SnackBar when the unread payment count increases, even on child screens; "Xem" opens Finance on the notifications tab (3).

## KMP
- Route: `Routes.Workspace` ("workspace") · app bar "Không gian làm việc"

- Registered by graph: `workspaceGraph`
- `shared/clinic` domain functions imported by the file (shared by every screen in it): `patientJourneyTimeline`
- Shot test: `pema-kmp/feature/finance/src/jvmTest/kotlin/com/pema/clinic/feature/finance/FinanceShotsTest.kt:121` → `pema-kmp/feature/workspace/build/shots/A7-vs.png`

## Business rules
- The clinic owner has 5 tabs: "Hôm nay" / "Lịch hẹn" / "Hồ sơ" / "Theo dõi" / "Thêm". The bottom nav belongs to Workspace, not a global nav.

## Accepted differences from the canvas
- Real Pema logo instead of the canvas "pema" text.
- Real sample data (46 records) instead of illustrative names.

## Gotchas / notes
- The selected tab must be `rememberSaveable`: NavHost drops `remember` when pushing a child route, so coming back would reset to tab 0.
